2609.33822.title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
2609.33822.paper_summary: An agent harness controls how a language model accesses information, uses tools, preserves memory, and checks its work. Improving this software is costly when each evaluation requires a long interaction with an environment. We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model. Its organizing overhypothesis is that tasks of a shared kind may exhibit recurring failures whose remedies transfer within that kind. Vestrum expresses failures as recognizable classes, proposes changes across verification, retrieval, decomposition, and knowledge synthesis, and screens their scope before evaluating them as a bundle. A persistent lessons file informs subsequent proposals. Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench. Across our searches, verification grounded in evidence helped both intermediate steps and final answers, at lower cost at intermediate steps, while critics asked to rebuild finished answers broke more than they repaired. On the three memory benchmarks, Vestrum also scores above the evaluated GEPA configurations in every paired evaluation.
2609.33822.paper_summary_zh: 一個代理控制如何讓語言模型訪問信息、使用工具、保留記憶和檢查其工作。當每次評估都需要與環境進行長時間互動時，改善這個軟件的成本很高。我們介紹Vestrum，一個將執行痕跡中的失敗轉化為範疇控制變更的框架，而無需訓練任務模型。它的組織性過度假設是，共享類型的任務可能會表現出重複的失敗，其補救措施可以在該類型內轉移。Vestrum將失敗表達為可識別的類別，提出在驗證、檢索、分解和知識合成中的變更，並在將其作為一個整體進行評估之前篩選其範疇。一個持久的教訓文件為後續提案提供信息。在五個設置和兩個基準控制下，凍結的控制改善了保留的性能：UltraHorizon在GAM上從47.6上升到59.8，Terminal-Bench 4 Hard在八個保留任務上從63.7%上升到70.3%的檢查通過率，測試成本為1.03x，並且在一張幻燈片的保留部分上，細胞類型註釋一致性從67.5%上升到77.8%，同時在LoCoMo和AMA-Bench上也有增長。在我們的搜索中，基於證據的驗證幫助了中間步驟和最終答案，在中間步驟的成本較低，而被要求重建完成答案的批評者比修復的更多。在三個記憶基準上，Vestrum在每次配對評估中也得分高於評估的GEPA配置。
